CustomHostname.label: Zabbix hostname (Custom mode)
CustomHostname.help: Used only in Custom mode. Must match the technical host name in Zabbix.

PSKSecretValue.label: PSK key (hex)
PSKSecretValue.help: Paste the contents of psk.key: 32–512 hexadecimal characters. Do not save a live key as a default.

PSKFile.label: PSK file path
PSKFile.help: Created on Apply if missing. For key rotation, use a new file path.
